description: Run the Dev Kit checker on the game folder. play=false: static checks (syntax, unknown gb.* calls, blocked browser APIs, imports, file limits). play=true: also plays the game headless inside GrowBlocks for some seconds, reports every runtime error and returns a screenshot. Run it after every change; fix everything it reports.

dir.description: The game folder (default: the folder the assistant runs in).

name: growblocks_check
title: Check and play the game
